name: CraftEngineer SmartCommerce AI
author: WP Craft Engineer

sections.description:
CraftEngineer SmartCommerce AI is an all-in-one toolkit designed to add practical AI-powered workflows to WordPress and WooCommerce websites.

It is built for store owners, agencies, developers, and content teams who want to speed up everyday work inside the WordPress dashboard while keeping control of how AI features are used.

This plugin includes tools for:

  • AI-assisted content generation for posts, pages, and WooCommerce products
  • Frontend chatbot support for general website queries and product-related questions
  • WooCommerce recommendation blocks for related or highlighted products
  • SEO helper tools for faster content optimization workflows
  • Custom post type builder with frontend shortcode output
  • Central settings for choosing and configuring supported AI providers

The plugin is designed so each feature can support practical business use cases such as:

  • generating draft product descriptions
  • improving category and collection copy
  • helping visitors find products through chat
  • building reusable custom content sections
  • showing dynamic recommendation areas in store layouts
  • reducing repetitive content and admin work

Features

AI Content Generator

Generate draft content for posts, pages, WooCommerce products, and other publishing workflows. This can help with first drafts, rewrite assistance, and content ideation.

Frontend Chatbot

Adds a customer-facing chatbot interface that can be used to answer basic site questions and support store discovery flows.

WooCommerce Recommendations

Displays recommendation blocks that can be used on store pages, landing pages, or content sections.

CPT Builder

Create custom post type configurations and display content on the frontend with shortcode support.

SEO Helper Tools

Provides basic SEO-oriented assistance to help structure and improve content workflows.

Modular Admin Settings

Includes admin settings to manage AI provider keys and feature behavior from one place.

External services

This plugin can connect to third-party AI services to generate content and chatbot responses. These services are only used when an administrator or site visitor actively triggers an AI feature that requires them.

OpenAI

This service is used to generate chatbot replies and AI content.
Data sent: prompts, instructions, conversation content, and related site content needed to generate the requested response.
When sent: when an administrator or site visitor uses an enabled AI feature.
Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Google Gemini

This service is used to generate chatbot replies and AI content.
Data sent: prompts, instructions, conversation content, and related site content needed to generate the requested response.
When sent: when an administrator or site visitor uses an enabled AI feature.
Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Shortcodes

[wceai_cpt_list type="portfolio"]

[wceai_cpt_list type="portfolio" posts="6" layout="grid" columns="3"]

[ssai_recommendations]<h3>Use Cases</h3>

* Create draft WooCommerce product content faster
* Add a basic AI assistant to customer-facing pages
* Build custom content sections with CPT output
* Display recommendation areas inside store pages
* Support faster editorial and merchandising workflows
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it through the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open CraftEngineer SmartCommerce AI in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Choose an AI provider and add your API key in the settings screen.
  5. Save settings.
  6. Configure the modules you want to use.
  7. Add the provided shortcodes where needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is optional. Some commerce-related features require WooCommerce to be active.

Which AI providers are supported?

OpenAI and Google Gemini.

Can I use only one module and ignore the others?

Yes. You can use the parts of the plugin that fit your workflow and leave the rest unused.

What shortcode does the CPT builder use?

[wceai_cpt_list type=”portfolio”]

Is this a replacement for manual editing?

No. The generated output should always be reviewed and edited before publishing on a live website.
